note: The Map groups zones into regions. upcoming lists areas from the world plan that aren't built yet; the Map shows the first one as a teaser card in its region. Each region has a painted map (map.art, a backdrop in assets.json) with pins at [x, y] fractions; an upcoming area's pin is on its entry. Adding an area to a map is one more pin. Planned spots on the Beyond the Peak map: Emberwild [0.24, 0.52], Skyreach Isles [0.76, 0.51], Hollow Crown [0.25, 0.31], Starfall Summit [0.66, 0.15].

regions.name: The Wilds
regions.blurb: Woods, shores and smoking hills close to home.

regions.name: The High Lands
regions.blurb: Storm peaks, frozen lakes and the deep places of the world.

regions.name: Beyond the Peak
regions.blurb: Nobody has come back from here yet. Well, nobody has gone.

upcoming.name: Sunken Spires
upcoming.blurb: A drowned city where storms walk on the water. The first land beyond the peak.
